test_title: PYST 18: SSC CHSL 2024 - Reasoning (Held On: 05 Jul, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Three statements are followed by conclusions numbered I, II. You have to consider these statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts. Decide which of the given conclusions logically follow/s from the given statement.

**Statements:**

All jams are butter.

Some nibs are ink.

Some nibs are butter.

**Conclusion (I): **Some ink is butter.

**Conclusion (II):** All jams are nibs.
solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b989411dca836c5a103d578deffe4239338c54d63c5431c3ccc2485e8bc6278e.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some ink is butter → Does not follow (As some nibs are ink and some nibs are butter. So, it is possible but not definitely true.)

II. All jams are nibs → Does not follow (As all jams are butter and some nibs are butter. So, it is possible but not definitely true.)

∴ Here, Neither conclusion (I) nor (II) follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4"
